_comment: Shipped preset for MiniMax H3 reference-to-video+audio (r2v). The workflow is ComfyUI's bundled video_minimax_h3_r2v template extended to the model's full reference capacity: 9 reference-image branches (LoadImage 137/139/201..207 -> ref_images.ref_image_0..8 on MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo #136) and 2 reference-video branches with paired soundtracks (LoadVideo 301/303 -> GetVideoComponents 302/304 -> ref_videos.ref_video_k + ref_video_audios.ref_video_audio_k). The stage prompt reaches #136 via PrimitiveStringMultiline #138; width/height come from the stage's resolution + aspect via computed:width/height (snap 32); duration_s feeds PrimitiveFloat #132 and ComfyMathExpression #131 snaps frames onto the 17k+5 grid. Unused reference branches are pruned at run time via drop_upstream_of, so exactly as many references are sent as are wired. mention_style=minimax_tags makes @image_N / @video_N / @audio_N in the stage prompt expand to the literal <Picture n> / <Video n> / <Audio n> tags the model was trained on.
label: Local MiniMax H3 R2V
description: MiniMax H3 reference-to-video+audio. Wire up to 9 reference images and up to 2 reference videos (their soundtracks ride along) into the stage; mention them in the prompt as @image_N / @video_N / @audio_N. Generates 5s of 1344x768 video WITH audio. Keep reference videos short (2-5s) — their tokens ride through every sampling step. Requires the MiniMax H3 model files — see workflows/video/README.md.
